description: Update an inbound forward rule. Only the provided fields change; a provided `conditions` or `destinations` array replaces the whole set (`[]` clears it).

inputSchema.description: At least one of `name`, `conditions`, or `destinations` must be provided. Fields left out are unchanged.

conditions.description: Replaces the whole condition set. An empty array removes all conditions, so the rule matches every message.

operator.description: Comparison operator. `empty` and `not_empty` are only valid for `header` conditions.

value.description: Text to compare against. Required for every operator except `empty` and `not_empty`.

destinations.description: Replaces the whole destination set. An empty array removes all destinations.

name.description: Rule name. Must be unique within the inbox.

name: update-inbound-forward-rule
